copy.tagline: 用6个问题完成AIMS内部审计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备ISO/IEC 42001认证或需要定期内审AI管理体系
copy.tagline_en: Complete AIMS internal audit with 6 questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if preparing for ISO/IEC 42001 certification or need regular AIMS internal audits

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 ISO/IEC 42001 标准对指定范围的 AI 管理系统提出六个关键问题，核对范围声明、AI 政策、风险登记与审计计划，最后输出差距分析、风险清单、审计排程、就绪结论和三项优先行动。
howto.when: 当你准备 ISO 42001 阶段一认证审核、启动年度内部审计，或将新 AI 系统纳入现有 AIMS 时触发。

say.text: 对当前所有 AI 系统做一次 AIMS 内部审计
say.note: 触发六问检查并生成差距分析报告

say.text: 生成 AI 风险登记册并映射到 Annex A 控制
say.note: 调用风险登记构建脚本

say.text: 制定 9.2 内部审计计划并检查审核员独立性
say.note: 调用审计排程脚本并输出计划

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies the ISO/IEC 42001 AIMS audit method: it asks six questions and produces a gap analysis, risk register, audit plan, readiness verdict, and top actions.
howto.when_en: Trigger when preparing for ISO 42001 Stage 1 certification, starting the annual internal audit, or onboarding a new AI system into the existing AIMS.

say_en.text: Run an AIMS internal audit on all current AI systems.
say_en.note: Triggers the six-question check and a gap analysis report.

say_en.text: Generate an AI risk register and map Annex A controls.
say_en.note: Calls the risk register builder script.

say_en.text: Create a Clause 9.2 internal audit plan and check auditor independence.
say_en.note: Calls the audit scheduler and outputs the plan.
